in_hebrew.name: Holt
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Holt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘holt’ meaning meaning ‘holly tree’. In Old English folklore, holly was believed to protect against witches and evil. The name Holt may also be derived from the Old Norse word ‘holmr’, meaning ‘island’ or ‘high ground’. In Christian symbolism, holly is associated with the Crown of Thorns and the Resurrection of Christ.
